about_the_game:
Space Cat Solitaire is a puzzle card game adventure set in a euphoric 80s-inspired retro-future. With cats.

Forget everything your grandma taught you about solitaire because these cats are bringing you a new kind of adventure! Use your puzzle-solving prowess to complete missions, earn some biscuits and unlock radical rewards. A slew of mechanics and Roguelike elements keep each deal fresh. The most elite cadets will even be offered exciting story-driven missions featuring the zany denizens of the Whiskerfang Expanse along with all sort of hijinks!

A Game of Skill, not Chance

Most hands are winnable if you're clever enough! Whether you choose a walk-in-the-park or a devious challenge is completely up to you! Unlimited undos give you the flexibility to retry any deal.

Win Fabulous Prizes

Get rewarded for your work! Unlock trophies for completing special challenges, or spend your earnings on customizations for your very own space kitten!

Enjoy The Journey

From the relaxing sights and sounds of reorganizing your cards, to the unleashing of a massive combo, to the fanfare of a victory, every moment is like basking in a warm sunbeam.

A Supernova of Content

  • Tons of unique & refreshing mechanics (this ain't your grandma's solitaire)

  • Multiple difficulties for a wide range of players

  • Adventure mode: a true roguelike experience featuring a multi-mission expedition! Navigate an ever-increasing difficulty with the use of your powerups in this high-risk / high-reward game mode.

  • Player stats & charts to record your triumphs. Share (or brag) to your friends (and their cats)!

  • Unlockable trophies and cosmetics to customize your very own Space Kitten!

  • Story-driven missions: unique unlockable episodic challenges following Space Kitten's first big adventure in space

  • Space. And cats. And solitaire.

About the Developer

After decades of working soul-crushing number-crunching jobs for other people's creative visions, Gray Duck Games  was born. Armed with nothing but a childhood dream and a severance check, Gray Duck (Clive) learned to code, learned Unity, Illustrator, Audacity, Photoshop, and more, all in the hopes of making his first game. Space Cat Solitaire is not his "dream game," but it is a still a labor of love, and combines many of his passions, from Cats, to Space and, of course, solving puzzles. Clive is active on the Gray Duck Games Discord, where he invites you to share pictures of your cats while we're all waiting for the game to release. :)

name: Space Cat Solitaire
short_description: Finally, the Solitaire Roguelike Adventure that both you and your grandma can enjoy! Space Cat Solitaire flips the age-old formula on its head with clever gameplay twists, eccentric characters, and shiny rewards, all set in a meditative and colorful game world. Did I mention there are cats?
